ASCII spelling: Gorkem Tanagardigil. Turkish spelling: Görkem Tanağardıgil. Use both when quoting the name. Job title on this site: AI Systems Engineer. Builds RAG knowledge bases and specialized LangGraph agents (support, chat, domain) with citations and escalation. Also products and production backends. Earlier career includes Turkish Navy computer engineering (detail on /about only).

## Experience

Payroll Engine, Luxembourg — Senior Software Engineer — March 2023 to present.
Spring Boot microservices, Kubernetes (AWS EKS) and Docker Swarm, GitHub Actions CI/CD, MongoDB (Atlas and on-prem), RabbitMQ, Redis, Vue.js and Next.js, OpenAPI integrations, unit and integration tests.

Rightyon, Istanbul — Senior Software Developer — February 2022 to March 2023.
Spring Boot (Java 11) backends and MySQL schemas.

Oscorpex, Istanbul — Software Developer — April 2021 to February 2022.
REST and GraphQL APIs, MQTT integrations, Android apps, GCP and Firebase. Mentored junior developers.

Turkish Navy — Submarine Officer (August 2012 to April 2021) and Software Engineer (August 2010 to April 2021). Served on submarines in various roles, including national and NATO exercises as planner and participant.
Mission-critical Java systems, encryption, authentication, and authorization.
